ranked.headline: Isoform-aware models and pipelines annotate transcripts and regulatory networks
ranked.summary: Long-read RNA-seq and computational models now resolve transcript isoforms, splicing regulators, and expression noise at population scale.

ranked.headline: Sequence-trained models predict methylation and enhancers while exposing motif syntax
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend sequence-based prediction to methylation, enhancers and cis-regulatory syntax, with interpretable attribution of model drivers.

ranked.headline: Unpaired and spatial omics modalities aligned via optimal transport and graph geometry
ranked.summary: Foundation models and spatial assays now produce heterogeneous embeddings that must be aligned across unpaired or out-of-distribution modalities.

ranked.headline: Computational integration of microbial omics with structural and metabolic context
ranked.summary: Protein language models, structural annotation, and taxon-resolved metrics now resolve microbial function and dysbiosis from omics and sequencing data.

ranked.headline: Polymer models, reference genomes and DNA shape reveal genome structure and variation
ranked.summary: Recent tools and references link 3D chromatin structure, cell line-matched genomes and structural variant mechanisms to specific genomic readouts.

ranked.headline: Probabilistic models are resolving cellular and somatic structure from sequencing data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers apply probabilistic and optimal-transport models to methylation, lineage, deconvolution, and multi-omic inference from noisy sequencing data.

ranked.headline: Language models now design and predict RNA and mRNA sequence function
ranked.summary: Sequence-based language models are moving from property prediction toward conditional design of RNA binders, mRNA UTRs, and codons.

ranked.headline: Omics models stratify disease and predict vaccine reactogenicity from transcriptomes
ranked.summary: Multi-omics and transcriptomic models are being built to stratify patients and predict outcomes, with attention to model form and cross-species transfer.

ranked.headline: Fitting plasticity rules and circuit architecture in neural models to behavioral data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers fit biomechanical and spiking network models directly to kinematic, decision, and timescale measurements.

ranked.headline: Learned models impute and integrate omics data across platforms, tissues, and missingness
ranked.summary: Deep generative and ensemble methods are now applied to imputation, cross-tissue association, and pathology image analysis across molecular data types.

ranked.headline: Epistatic omission biases GWAS nulls as isoform and non-coding variant mapping advances
ranked.summary: Mapping genetic effects onto intermediate phenotypes now demands explicit control of null bias, interaction terms, and isoform-level resolution.

ranked.headline: Chromosome fusions, genome-wide coupling and ion channel diversity across animals
ranked.summary: Chromosome-level and population-genomic datasets now resolve how fusions, hybrid coupling and gene-family diversity shape animal genome evolution.

ranked.headline: Simulations show how lipids, peptides, and mutations reshape protein assembly states
ranked.summary: Microsecond and multiscale simulations now resolve how lipids, peptides, and mutations gate conformational and assembly transitions.

ranked.headline: Reference-based benchmarks test sequencing and proteomics informatics tools
ranked.summary: Recent papers benchmark TCR-seq, nanopore RNA and DIA proteomics workflows against measured reference data or defined analysis steps.

ranked.headline: Graph and latent models of EEG, fMRI and connectome data for brain connectivity
ranked.summary: Multimodal graph fusion, higher-order complexes, and hybrid latent models are now applied to EEG, fMRI, and structural connectome data.

ranked.headline: Protein language model embeddings predict binding, epitopes, and designed sequences
ranked.summary: CONFIDE and biocentral add reliability metrics and standardized embedding access as sequence-based models extend to binding affinity and epitope prediction.

ranked.headline: Local stochastic rules shape collective outcomes in chemotaxis and membrane proteins
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study model individual-agent stochasticity as the link between local rules and collective system behavior.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking and input design shape phylogenetic inference accuracy
ranked.summary: Recent work benchmarks phylogenetic inference tools on simulated and empirical alignments and tests mixed-length HIV-1 alignment inputs.

ranked.headline: Bistable models link cellular state transitions to disease onset and tissue injury
ranked.summary: Phase-plane and agent-based models now frame aggregation, glial depolarization, and mechanical injury as threshold-like state transitions.

ranked.headline: Learned models sharpen variant, copy number, and splice calls from sequencing data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a proteome-wide model report calibrated or exact genotype-to-impact predictions from exome and genome sequencing data.

ranked.headline: Population-scale tools for ancestry, haplogroup and linkage disequilibrium inference
ranked.summary: Population-scale ancestry and variation analyses increasingly depend on reproducible, species-specific reference resources and scoring tools.

ranked.headline: Methods for gene specificity and co-expression in single-cell and spatial transcriptomics
ranked.summary: Recent work tests gene-level statistics in single-cell and spatial data, including a benchmark across more than 50 spatial datasets.

ranked.headline: Single-cell and bulk genomic data used to infer regulatory variants and networks
ranked.summary: Recent items pair deep learning, single-cell eQTL integration, and sex-stratified networks to link noncoding variation with disease risk.

ranked.headline: Structure-guided generative design of binders, hybrid proteins, and antibody libraries
ranked.summary: Generative design tools increasingly co-optimize sequence, stereochemistry, and 3D structural constraints for binders, antibodies, and coarse-grained models.

ranked.headline: Simulations map Wnt receptor trafficking and breast cancer plasticity dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent models link membrane receptor trafficking to sustained Wnt pathway activity and tie plasticity axes in ER+ breast cancer to survival outcomes.

ranked.headline: Molecular graph networks fused with multimodal inputs for drug response prediction
ranked.summary: Graph models paired with cell-line, image, and fingerprint inputs now span toxicity, potency, and combination synergy endpoints.

ranked.headline: Compressed indexes and banded alignment reduce memory in large sequence analyses
ranked.summary: Million-genome collections and long-read data make memory-efficient sketch indexing and banded alignment practical on standard hardware.

ranked.headline: Computational methods for interaction mapping, tissue imaging and EV protein tracing
ranked.summary: Recent preprints use computational modeling to extract protein-level information from pooled IP-MS, multiplexed imaging and labeled vesicle proteomics.

ranked.headline: Interpretability and debiasing scrutinize sequence-based bioactivity prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published benchmark test whether sequence-based predictors remain valid under explainability probes and debiased data splits.

ranked.headline: Multi-omic data and thermodynamic constraints refine metabolic network models
ranked.summary: Recent tools add thermodynamic feasibility and time-course fitting to metabolic models, alongside multi-omic regulatory network inference.

ranked.headline: Nominating candidate targets and biomarkers from multi-source genomic and clinical data
ranked.summary: Expanding curated resources and sequence-level tools now allow systematic prioritization of essential proteins, cancer biomarkers, and Z-DNA regions.

ranked.headline: Sequence language models target edit distance, structure search and interaction sites
ranked.summary: Recent work reuses embeddings from pretrained biological sequence models for alignment-free comparison, structure search, and interface prediction.

ranked.headline: Topological and higher-order representations move beyond pairwise biological networks
ranked.summary: Mapper topology, belief propagation, and triadic mining each recast gene and brain data beyond pairwise edges.

ranked.headline: Structured models reconciling heterogeneous data across labs, species, and time points
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a 2025 publication pair explicit model structure with alignment across heterogeneous sources, laboratories, and time points.

ranked.headline: Convergent SARS-CoV-2 antibody paratopes and near-universal variant escape
ranked.summary: Structure-resolved antibody collections and standardized binding databases now enable systematic comparison of antigen recognition and immune escape.

ranked.headline: Generative and velocity-field registration map mouse brain data onto common atlases
ranked.summary: Multimodal whole-brain datasets are now aligned to shared atlases with quantitative readouts of cell density and geometric variation.

ranked.headline: Productive reiterative initiation and de novo microproteins in enterobacteria
ranked.summary: Genome-wide nascent RNA profiling and smORF analyses in enterobacteria are refining views of promoter-level transcription and microprotein emergence.

ranked.headline: MD and cryo-EM reveal lipid and anion control of transporter conformational barriers
ranked.summary: Recent MD, Markov modeling, and cryo-EM studies resolve electrostatic and lipid determinants of conformational transitions in CFTR, AE1, and NarU.

ranked.headline: NMR-guided simulations resolve dynamics of disordered and partly folded proteins
ranked.summary: NMR-informed simulations and refined force fields are now used to model protein ensembles, binding entropy, and oligomer stabilization.

ranked.headline: Reproducible pipelines extend from network disease modules to docking and LLM gene sets
ranked.summary: Pipelines are moving beyond preprocessing toward benchmarking, drug repurposing, and gene set curation, with conversational and multi-agent interfaces.
